title: Soviet psychics tasked against US congressmen, senators, cabinet and president
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Soviet psychics tasked against US congressmen, senators, cabinet and president, about Soviet era at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: times so they taught their psychics to Target American Congressman uh Senators

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man known for his work as a psychic, says the Soviet Union trained its own psychics to spy with their minds on American congressmen, senators, members of the president's cabinet and the president himself. He says he learned this from a box of material that came from a Soviet psychic unit. If true, it would mean both sides of the Cold War took mind-spying seriously enough to aim it at the top of government.
